source_instruction: i'm looking for a 32 ounce package of gluten free almond flour.
query: Oh man, my cat just knocked over my favorite ceramic succulent pot this morning, dirt got all over the entryway rug and I had to spend 20 minutes vacuuming it up before I could even think about making my grocery list. I also realized I forgot to pick up dry cleaning on my way home yesterday, so my nice work button-down is still sitting there waiting for me, and I need to remember to grab it after this errand run. Also, the new season of that baking competition show dropped last night and I stayed up way too late binging the first three episodes, so I’m running on way too much iced coffee right now. Anyway, I’m looking for pantry staples that are gluten free, come in a 32 ounce size, are kosher certified, and cost no more than $30 total.
